sentences.text: Aggrieved of the aforesaid award dated 07.05.1991, the present Regular First Appeal (RFA) has been filed at the instance of appellant-State.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the appellant and gone through the paper-book.
I am unable to find substance in the submissions made on behalf of the appellant.

7. In the present case, acquisition proceedings were carried out vide notifications dated 16.12.1976 and 22.02.1977 issued under Sections 4 and 6 of the Act respectively qua the land forming part of revenue estate of village Bathinda Patti Jhuttike.

Pertaining to the same acquisition, this Court vide its judgment passed in RFA-407-1981 titled as "Bhagwanti Vs. Punjab State" has already assessed the market value @ Rs.16/- per square yard and the impugned award has been passed by the learned Reference Court on the basis of the decision made by this Court in the aforementioned RFA.

8. As such, there being no evidence on record to show any kind of dissimilarity between the parcels of land forming part of same acquisition, therefore, no interference is called for with the order passed by learned Reference Court on 07.05.1991 and the present appeal is thus, dismissed, being devoid of merits.
9. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.

04.12.2025 (HARKESH MANUJA)
